genericNotFoundError.description: Generic message about not found error for any object.

taskObj.description:
Task object.
To enable error details use query parameter 'withErrorDetails=true'.
To enable task details use query parameter 'withTaskDetails=true'.

tasksList.description:
Tasks list.
To enable error details use query parameter 'withErrorDetails=true'.

enabled.description:
Enabled indicates whether kubernetes audit logs should be collected
and pushed into SIEM system (e.g. logstash).
False by default.

secret_name.description:
SecretName contains name of the kubernetes secret in namespace kube-system
with credentials of SIEM system where logs should be pushed.
Fields of the secret: host, port, username (optional), password (optional), ca.crt (optional).
This field is optional. By default, used mks-audit-logs.
Secret name should be as a DNS subdomain name as defined in RFC 1123.
More: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/names/#dns-subdomain-names

AvailableAdmissionControllers.description:
AvailableAdmissionControllers represents detailed info about available admission controllers
for every k8s minor version.

AvailableFeatureGates.description:
AvailableFeatureGates represents detailed info about available feature gates
for every k8s minor version.

CNICiliumSettings.description:
CNICiliumSettings
represents settings for Cilium CNI if this CNI was chosen as "cni_type",
otherwise settings will be ignored.

envoy_daemonset.description: EnvoyDaemonset Enables Envoy DaemonSet for Cilium CNI.

hubble_relay.description: HubbleRelay Enables hubble relay for Cilium CNI.

additional_software.description: AdditionalSoftware represents information about additional software installed in the cluster.

cluster_type.description: ClusterType represents the type of the cluster.

cni_type.description:
CniType CNI type represents type of CNI which will be used in cluster.
Supported CNI types are CALICO and CILIUM.

created_at.description: CreatedAt is the timestamp in UTC timezone of when the cluster has been created.

enable_autorepair.description:
EnableAutorepair reflects if worker nodes are allowed to be reinstalled automatically
in case of their unavailability or unhealthiness.

enable_patch_version_auto_upgrade.description:
EnablePatchVersionAutoUpgrade specifies if Kubernetes version of the cluster is allowed to be upgraded
automatically.

id.description: ID is the identifier of the cluster.

kube_api_ip.description: KubeAPIIP represents the IP of the Kubernetes API.

kube_version.description: KubeVersion represents the current Kubernetes version of the cluster.

name.description: Name represents the name of the cluster.

network_id.description: NetworkID contains reference to the network of the cluster.

private_kube_api.description: PrivateKubeAPI represents if kube API is available from the Internet or not.

project_id.description: ProjectID contains reference to the project of the cluster.

region.description: Region represents the region of where the cluster is located.

status.description: Status represents current status of the cluster.

subnet_id.description: SubnetID contains reference to the subnet of the cluster.

updated_at.description: UpdatedAt is the timestamp in UTC timezone of when the cluster has been updated.

zonal.description:
Zonal specifies that cluster has only a single master and that
control-plane is not in highly available mode.
